test_title: PYST 32: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word from the following sentence.**

Leisure

He was relaxing and enjoying last week in Spain but now he is working hard for the firm.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Working**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Leisure **means free time or relaxation, so the opposite would be something related to work or effort. (खाली समय या विश्राम)

 
 
• **Example**: *After completing the demanding project, she decided to spend her Saturday in leisure, reading a book in the cosy corner of her home.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Working **means engaging in activities related to employment or the act of doing a job or tasks for a living. (रोज़गार से संबंधित गतिविधियों में संलग्न होना या आजीविका के लिए नौकरी या कार्य करना)
 
 
• **Example**: *She spent the entire day working on her computer, preparing reports and responding to emails.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Enjoying**: Finding pleasure or satisfaction in an activity. (किसी गतिविधि में आनंद या संतुष्टि ढूँढना)
 
• **Relaxing**: Unwinding or reducing stress, promoting a sense of calmness. (तनाव को कम करना या कम करना, शांति की भावना को बढ़ावा देना)
 
• **Hard**: Difficult or requiring a significant amount of effort. (कठिन या बहुत अधिक प्रयास की आवश्यकता)
